Hi Lindsey — great to hear Rajiv can join. Dec 8 or 9 at 3:30pm PT is doable on our end. Quick notes:

- We can hold Dec 8, 3:30–4:15pm PT as a provisional slot. If you prefer Dec 9, we can switch — please confirm by end of week.
- Dry run: absolutely. We suggest a 30-minute tech dry run with our lead engineer (Priyom) on the day prior at 12:00pm PT if that aligns with your team.
- Recording policy: Redwood does record sessions by default for internal QA but we can disable retention and provide a one-time ephemeral recording on request. For external auditors/legal, we can provide a short policy note and the SOW that outlines data handling — cc'ing Priyom and Ben for details.

Proposed next steps:
1) Lindsey confirms preferred date (Dec 8 or 9)
2) Alexa confirms if dry run at 12:00pm PT works for Rajiv or his delegate
3) We’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and a brief pre-demo checklist

Thanks — looking forward.

Hi Alexa — thanks for the preference. Quick answers from tech/legal side:

- Dry run: we can do Dec 8 at 11:00am PT (30 minutes) with our lead engineer (me) to run through connectivity, agenda, and any live data concerns. That should be fast and hands-on.

- Recording policy (short): Redwood records streaming sessions by default for internal debugging and quality monitoring. For customer execs we offer a \"no-retention\" setting: an ephemeral recording can be produced for immediate playback during the session and then deleted within 7 days, with a signed request. We do not transcribe or index ephemeral recordings unless explicitly authorized. Transcripts/analytics are only generated if the customer opts in.

If a formal clause is needed in the SOW, we can add a short paragraph and share a DocuSign-ready SOW (attached: SOW_Arcturus_v2.docx).

Action items:
- Alexa: confirm Dec 9, 3:30–4:15pm PT for exec slot
- Alexa: confirm dry run Dec 8 at 11:00am PT or request Dec 9 at 11:30am PT
- Marissa/Ben: prepare a 10‑minute product highlight + 20 minute demo plan; we'll keep extra 5–10 minutes for Q&A

Thanks — Priyom
